UNCA ML (+140) at +140: the algo gave it 40% vs 40% fair (-0.1 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the close (closing fair chance 42%). TNTC ML (-166) at -166: the algo gave it 60% vs 60% fair (+0.1 pts) — won (+0.6u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 58%). UNCA +3.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. TNTC -3.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (0 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. OVER 163.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-1.7 pts) — won (+0.9u); beat the closing 164.5 by 1. UNDER 163.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+1.7 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the closing 164.5 by 1.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: total 163.5 → 164.5. The total moved away from the algo's number.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 50% of bets on Golden Eagles, 54% of the money — Golden Eagles covered; total: 13% of bets on the over, 59% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 83% of bets on Golden Eagles, 59% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Golden Eagles, who won and covered.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.119 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -16.5 points. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 713 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.981 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Golden Eagles attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (4 games); Bulldogs attack ×0.996, defense ×1.008 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 17.6 points), no bet.
